$comment: Upstream malware records that no mapping can turn into a feed IOC, recorded so the gap is visible rather than silent. Unlike threat-feed-declined.json this claims NO coverage: every entry here is a detection gap. npm run feed:reconcile fails on any unmappable record NOT listed here, and reports a listed id that has since become mappable as stale. See docs/threat-feed-sources.md.
